data.name: Collect.Tip
data.value: Run the virtual printer service and add every job you print to the pool

data.name: PrinterSetup.Tip
data.value: Creates the Windows printer queue that feeds OpenLeanPrint. Needs administrator rights once.

data.name: Layout.Tip
data.value: How many pages go on one sheet. These buttons are the usual choices and simply fill in the Grid box next to them.

data.name: Preset.2up.Tip
data.value: Two pages per sheet: stacked and turned sideways, which fills the sheet. Side by side upright is 1x2 in the Grid box.

data.name: Grid.Tip
data.value: Pages per sheet, as rows × columns: 2x2 puts four pages on a sheet — the same thing the 4-up button does. Type anything the buttons do not cover, such as 2x3, 1x4, or just a count like 6. The box always shows the layout in force, which is why choosing 4-up writes 2x2 here.

data.name: Margin.Tip
data.value: The blank border around the whole sheet. Leave 10 mm or more if the sheets are to be stapled or punched.

data.name: Gutter.Tip
data.value: The space between the pages on a sheet. Margin is the border around the outside, gutter is the gap in the middle - with a 1x1 layout it does nothing at all.

data.name: PageBorders.Tip
data.value: Draws a thin frame around every page. Without one, four pages on a sheet with white space between them read as a single crowded page.

data.name: Watermark.Tip
data.value: Text drawn diagonally across every sheet, e.g. DRAFT. Empty means none.

data.name: Profile.Tip
data.value: Pick a saved layout, or type a name and press Save to keep the current one.

data.name: PrintClose.Tip
data.value: Print, empty the pool and put the window away. The usual end of a job: what you have printed is done with.

data.name: Print.Tip
data.value: Print and leave everything as it is - for a second copy, or another printer.

data.name: Sides.Tip
data.value: Long edge is the usual choice for upright sheets - the back reads like the next page of a book. Booklets need short edge instead: their sheets are landscape, so flipping the long edge prints every second side upside down. What was actually applied is reported after printing.

data.name: Pool.Hint
data.value: One entry per PDF. They are laid onto shared sheets in this order — use ↑ ↓ to change it. Select one to choose which of its pages to print; the preview jumps to it.

data.name: Pages.Tip
data.value: Which pages of the selected job to print, e.g. 1-4,7 or 3-. Empty means all.

data.name: Menu.RestoreJob
data.value: Print all pages of this job

data.name: Pool.Empty
data.value: Drop PDFs here, or use Add PDFs — or switch on “Collect captured jobs” and print from any application. Several jobs are combined onto shared sheets, in this order.

data.name: Preview.Tip
data.value: Right-click a page in the preview to remove it.

data.name: Status.Elevated
data.value: Running as administrator. Nothing here needs that - close it and start it normally.

data.name: Status.Listening
data.value: Listening for print jobs on port {0}.

data.name: Status.FromService
data.value: Collecting jobs from the Open-LeanPrint service.

data.name: Status.PortBusy
data.value: Port {0} is in use by something else; watching the capture folders.

data.name: Status.Skipped
data.value: {0} older captured jobs were left in the folder.

data.name: Status.LastPage
data.value: That is the last page left - remove the job instead.

data.name: Status.ProfileNameNeeded
data.value: Type a name for the profile first.

data.name: Status.NoListener
data.value: Nothing is listening for print jobs, so the printer cannot be created yet.

data.name: Status.PrinterReady
data.value: The Open-LeanPrint printer is ready - print to it from any application.

data.name: Status.PrinterNotCreated
data.value: The printer was not created. Administrator rights are needed for that one step.

data.name: Sides.Unsupported
data.value: This printer cannot print two-sided, so it went out single-sided.

data.name: Sides.Long
data.value: Two-sided, flipped on the long edge.

data.name: Sides.Short
data.value: Two-sided, flipped on the short edge.

data.name: Sides.Default
data.value: Sides left to the printer's own setting.

data.name: Dialog.AddTitle
data.value: Add PDFs to the job pool

data.name: Dialog.SetupText
data.value:
Open-LeanPrint can add its virtual printer now, so you can print into it from any application.
Windows will ask for administrator rights once - creating a printer queue requires them.

data.name: Balloon.StillCollecting.Text
data.value: The pool is empty and Open-LeanPrint keeps collecting. Double-click the tray icon to bring it back.

data.name: Tray.PopUp
data.value: Show the window when a job arrives

data.name: Tray.NoticeOnHide
data.value: Tell me when the window goes to the tray
